items.text: Beef resource links restored, fixing missing beef items.
Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to the safezone.
Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle prevented proper interaction; updated sheep prefab.
Added support for mounting generation‑2 AI creatures via a new NPCMountable component.
Fence gate opening/closing speed halved for smoother operation.
Fences can now be demolished with a hammer, show a blue highlight when demolishable, and have server‑side colliders and refined lock positions fixed.
Gamepad key‑binding menu no longer crashes when closed mid‑assignment.
Fixed key latching issues when input is cleared, preventing unintended F1 console opening.
Fixed map UI binding so the close‑map action works correctly.
Adjusted salvaged cleaver weapon distance for proper reach.
Fixed hitbox collision detection to improve combat accuracy.
Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference, ensuring it can be cooked properly.
Added new meat types to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Animals & Farming
- Beef resource links restored, fixing missing beef items.
- Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
- Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to the safezone.
- Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle prevented proper interaction; updated sheep prefab.
- Added support for mounting generation‑2 AI creatures via a new NPCMountable component.

### Building & Structures
- Fence gate opening/closing speed halved for smoother operation.
- Fences can now be demolished with a hammer, show a blue highlight when demolishable, and have server‑side colliders and refined lock positions fixed.

### UI & Controls
- Gamepad key‑binding menu no longer crashes when closed mid‑assignment.
- Fixed key latching issues when input is cleared, preventing unintended F1 console opening.
- Fixed map UI binding so the close‑map action works correctly.

### Weapons & Combat
- Adjusted salvaged cleaver weapon distance for proper reach.
- Fixed hitbox collision detection to improve combat accuracy.

### Cooking & Food
- Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference, ensuring it can be cooked properly.
- Added new meat types to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.
